name: Dynamic Resource Allocation Under Uncertainty
description: Allocate limited resources across tasks with uncertain durations to maximise expected utility.
input_format: Tasks with priority weights, duration estimates, deadlines, total budget
output_format: Allocation plan with expected utility and risk assessment
steps: Compute expected completion time per resource fraction

example.output: Allocate 0.7 to A, 0.3 to B. Expected utility=14.2
example.explanation: A has higher priority and tighter deadline
